name: Capri (Italy)
description: Horizontal bicolour of white and green, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Capri (Saint Constantius on white) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Capri, a comune in Campania; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Capri arms — Saint Constantius on white, crowned, within branches
